name: Printify
label: Printify REST v1 — shops, products, orders
description: Printify API v1. Bearer token. Customer warrants artwork rights. trigger is shop webhooks (ingress).
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One official API operation. Secrets stay in configurationParameters.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Official API verb. EXACT: shop_list | product_create | product_publish | order_submit | order_get | trigger. Blank uses configurationParameters.operation. trigger is ingress (BPMN message event), not an HTTP call.

schema.label: product_id
schema.description: URL path parameter `product_id` for operation: product_publish. Required by: product_publish.

schema.label: order_id
schema.description: URL path parameter `order_id` for operation: order_get. Required by: order_get.

schema.label: title
schema.description: Product title for product_create; also a publish flag (boolean true) on product_publish when publishing the title. Example: Classic Tee.

schema.label: description
schema.description: Product HTML description for product_create; publish flag on product_publish. Example: 100% cotton.

schema.label: blueprint_id
schema.description: Printify catalog blueprint id. Required on product_create. Example: 384.

schema.label: print_provider_id
schema.description: Print provider id. Required on product_create. Example: 1.

schema.label: variants
schema.description: product_create variant list [{id, price, is_enabled}]. Also a publish flag on product_publish. Example: [{"id":45740,"price":2100,"is_enabled":true}].

schema.label: print_areas
schema.description: product_create print areas with placeholders/images. Example: [{"variant_ids":[45740],"placeholders":[{"position":"front","images":[]}]}].

schema.label: tags
schema.description: Product tags on product_create, or publish flag on product_publish. Example: ["summer"].

schema.label: images
schema.description: product_publish: send true to publish images. Example: true.

schema.label: keyFeatures
schema.description: product_publish: send true to publish key features. Example: true.

schema.label: shipping_template
schema.description: product_publish: send true to publish the shipping template. Example: true.

schema.label: external_id
schema.description: Merchant order id for order_submit. Example: ORD-1001.

schema.label: label
schema.description: Optional order label for order_submit.

schema.label: line_items
schema.description: order_submit line items [{product_id, variant_id, quantity}]. Required. Example: [{"product_id":"abc","variant_id":45740,"quantity":1}].

schema.label: shipping_method
schema.description: order_submit shipping method id. Required. 1=standard. Example: 1.

schema.label: send_shipping_notification
schema.description: order_submit. Whether Printify emails the customer. Default false.

schema.label: address_to
schema.description: order_submit shipping address {first_name, last_name, email, phone, country, region, address1, city, zip}. Required. Example: {"first_name":"Ada","last_name":"Lovelace","email":"ada@example.com","country":"US","address1":"1 Market","city":"San Francisco","zip":"94105"}.

schema.label: shop_id
schema.description: Printify shop id. Path fallback when config shop_id is empty. Example: 1234567.

ports.name: output
ports.description: status=ok + data on 2xx. Secrets never present. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: status
schema.description: Exact ok on HTTP 2xx.

schema.label: http_status
schema.description: Provider HTTP status. Never includes secrets.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body. May contain order PII — do not log values.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: HTTP verb for OfficialApiNode. EXACT: shop_list | product_create | product_publish | order_submit | order_get | trigger. trigger does not open a socket.

configurationParameters.label: Api Token
configurationParameters.description: StudioQuack secret. Auth type bearer. Never log. Customer owns the merchant account.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout Seconds
configurationParameters.description: Per-request HTTP timeout seconds (connect + read). <=0 uses api_spec defaultTimeout.

configurationParameters.label: Webhook Key
configurationParameters.description: Engine Webhook API Key binding ($webhookKeyRef) routing inbound HTTP webhooks to this node.
